column1: [FR-ADM-012] Audit log for all admin actions
column32:
*FR-ADM-012:* All admin actions recorded in audit log (who, when, what changed).

*Priority:* Must (v2) | *Epic:* ECOM-10
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. AC

* Every admin write (product, inventory, order status, user deactivate) → audit row
* Fields: actor_user_id, action, target_type, target_id, before, after, timestamp
* Retained ≥ 365 days (NFR-OBS-006)
* Open question: separate DB or same?

*FR-ADM-011:* Admin can export CSV of orders for a given date range.

*Priority:* Could (v2) | *Epic:* ECOM-10
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. AC

* GET /api/admin/orders/export?from=...&to=... returns text/csv
* Includes order id, user, total, status, created_at
* Streamed response for large date ranges

*FR-ADM-010:* Admin-only metrics: total orders, revenue last N days, top products.

*Priority:* Should (v2) | *Epic:* ECOM-10
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. AC

* GET /api/admin/metrics returns aggregate JSON
* Supports ?period=7d|30d|90d
* Top products ordered by units sold

*FR-ADM-009:* Admin can deactivate user accounts; active sessions invalidated at next request.

*Priority:* Should (v2) | *Epic:* ECOM-10
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. AC

* PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/deactivate sets is_active=false
* Subsequent requests from deactivated user → 401 (FR-AUTH-005)
* Open question: should we revoke existing JWTs immediately or wait for expiry?

*FR-ADM-008:* All admin endpoints reject non-ADMIN users with HTTP 403.

*Priority:* Must (v2) | *Epic:* ECOM-10
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. AC

* USER role calling any /api/admin/* or /api/products POST/PUT/DELETE → 403
* No JWT → 401 (precedence: auth first, then role)
* FastAPI dependency centralises check

*FR-ADM-007:* Admin can transition order status per FR-ORD-011 lifecycle.

*Priority:* Must (v2) | *Epic:* ECOM-10
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. AC

* PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id}/status accepts new status
* Validates transition (no backwards moves)
* Audit log entry written
* Triggers notification email/SMS (v2)

column1: [FR-ADM-006] Admin lists all orders across users
column32:
*FR-ADM-006:* Admin can list all orders across all users, with pagination + status filter.

*Priority:* Must (v2) | *Epic:* ECOM-10
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. AC

* GET /api/admin/orders returns orders across users
* ?status=SHIPPED filters by status
* Pagination supported (page, limit)

column1: [FR-ADM-005] Admin can adjust inventory_count with audit
column32:
*FR-ADM-005:* Admin can adjust {{inventory_count}} directly; audit-log entry records old/new value + timestamp.

*Priority:* Must (v2) | *Epic:* ECOM-10
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. AC

* PATCH /api/products/{id}/inventory accepts new count or delta
* Audit row inserted with admin_user_id, product_id, old, new, timestamp
* Negative inventory not allowed (returns 400)

*FR-ADM-004:* Soft-delete (deactivate) by setting {{is_active=false}}; hard deletion forbidden to preserve historic order references.

*Priority:* Must (v2) | *Epic:* ECOM-10
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. AC

* DELETE /api/products/{id} (JWT + ADMIN) sets is_active=false, returns 204
* Historic OrderItem rows still reference the product
* Product disappears from public catalog (FR-CAT-007)

*FR-ADM-003:* The system SHALL allow ADMIN users to update any field of an existing product.

*Priority:* Must (v2) | *Epic:* ECOM-10
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. AC

* PUT /api/products/{id} (JWT + ADMIN) returns 200
* Partial updates allowed
* Audit log entry written (FR-ADM-012)

*FR-ADM-002:* The system SHALL allow ADMIN users to create products.

*Priority:* Must (v2) | *Epic:* ECOM-10
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. AC

* POST /api/products (JWT + ADMIN) returns 201
* All fields validated
* Non-admin gets 403

column1: [FR-ADM-001] Add role attribute to User (USER / ADMIN)
column32:
*FR-ADM-001:* The system SHALL introduce a {{role}} attribute on User with values USER (default) and ADMIN.

*Priority:* Must (v2) | *Epic:* ECOM-10
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. AC

* DB migration adds {{role}} column (default USER)
* JWT carries role claim
* Admin-only endpoints check role==ADMIN

*FR-ORD-015:* The system MAY send an email confirmation on successful order creation in v1.1.

*Priority:* Could (v1.1) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* Email triggered out-of-band (background job) after order commit
* Contains order id, item list, total
* Failure to send does NOT roll back the order

*FR-ORD-014:* The system SHOULD support an idempotency key on order creation so retried submissions do not produce duplicate orders.

*Priority:* Should | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* POST /api/orders with Idempotency-Key header
* Retry with same key returns the original order_id (not a new order)
* Key TTL ~24h, then key can be reused

column1: [FR-ORD-013] Cancel PENDING/CONFIRMED orders and restore stock
column32:
*FR-ORD-013:* The system SHOULD allow a user to cancel an order while its status is PENDING or CONFIRMED; cancellation MUST return reserved inventory.

*Priority:* Should | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* POST /api/orders/{id}/cancel returns 200, status=CANCELLED
* Inventory restored to product.inventory_count (atomic)
* Cancel on SHIPPED/DELIVERED returns 409

*FR-ORD-012:* The system SHALL persist the shipping address as captured at checkout, separately from the user's profile (a user may ship to many addresses).

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* order.shipping_address stored as free-text in v1
* Address NOT denormalized from a user profile (per-order)
* Open question: address book entity in v2?

*FR-ORD-011:* The system SHALL assign an initial order status of PENDING on creation and SHALL allow the lifecycle states: PENDING → CONFIRMED → SHIPPED → DELIVERED, plus CANCELLED as a terminal alternative.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* New orders start as PENDING
* Status enum enforced at API and DB
* Forward transitions only (no DELIVERED → PENDING)
* CANCELLED accepts from PENDING or CONFIRMED only

column1: [FR-ORD-010] Deny foreign-user orders with 404 (no existence leak)
column32:
*FR-ORD-010:* The system SHALL deny access to orders that do not belong to the authenticated user, returning HTTP 404 (not 403, to avoid leaking existence).

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* GET /api/orders/{id} where order belongs to another user → 404
* GET /api/orders/{id} where order doesn't exist → 404 (indistinguishable)
* Both responses use identical body

column1: [FR-ORD-009] Order detail endpoint with line items
column32:
*FR-ORD-009:* The system SHALL provide order detail (line items, totals, address, status, timestamps) for any order owned by the authenticated user.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* GET /api/orders/{id} returns full order + items
* Items show product_name, quantity, price_at_purchase, line_total
* Includes shipping_address, payment_method, status, created_at, updated_at

*FR-ORD-008:* The system SHALL list all orders belonging to the authenticated user, sorted by created_at descending.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* GET /api/orders returns 200 with array
* Only caller's orders included
* Newest first (created_at DESC)
* Each entry includes id, total, status, created_at

*FR-ORD-007:* The system SHALL compute and store total_amount as the sum of price_at_purchase × quantity over all order items.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* order.total_amount = sum(item.price_at_purchase * item.quantity)
* Persisted on order row (not computed on read)
* Verified by integration test summing line items

column1: [FR-ORD-006] Snapshot unit prices into order lines
column32:
*FR-ORD-006:* The system SHALL lock the unit price of each line into OrderItem.price_at_purchase at order creation time; subsequent product price changes MUST NOT alter historic orders.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* OrderItem row has price_at_purchase column set from product.price at creation time
* Updating product.price later does NOT change historic OrderItem rows
* order.total_amount derived from snapshotted prices, not live product prices

column1: [FR-ORD-005] Clear cart on successful order creation
column32:
*FR-ORD-005:* The system SHALL clear the user's cart on successful order creation (see FR-CART-011).

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* After 201 order created, GET /api/cart returns empty
* Cart clear part of same transaction (NFR-REL-003)
* See FR-CART-011 for the cart-side implementation

column1: [FR-ORD-004] Atomically decrement inventory at order creation
column32:
*FR-ORD-004:* The system SHALL atomically decrement inventory_count for each line as part of order creation; the operation MUST either fully succeed or fully roll back.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* All decrements + order insert + cart clear in single DB transaction
* Any failure rolls back ALL changes (no partial state)
* Concurrent checkouts of last unit: exactly one succeeds, one fails (no oversell)

column1: [FR-ORD-003] Validate stock and active state at order creation
column32:
*FR-ORD-003:* The system SHALL validate that every cart line refers to an active product with sufficient inventory at the time of order creation; insufficient stock returns HTTP 409.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* Any line with inventory_count < quantity → 409 with list of offending lines
* Any line with is_active=false → 409
* Validation done with row lock (FOR UPDATE) to avoid race

column1: [FR-ORD-002] Reject order creation when cart is empty
column32:
*FR-ORD-002:* The system SHALL reject order creation when the user's cart is empty, returning HTTP 400.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* POST /api/orders with empty cart → 400 reason=CART_EMPTY
* No order row inserted
* UI prevents the call by graying out "Place order" until cart has items

*FR-ORD-001:* The system SHALL allow an authenticated user with a non-empty cart to create an order by submitting shipping address and payment method.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-9
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. AC

* POST /api/orders {address, payment_method} returns 201 with order_id + total
* Order rows persisted (status=PENDING)
* Cart cleared in same tx (FR-CART-011)

column1: [FR-CART-015] Flag unavailable lines and exclude from total
column32:
*FR-CART-015:* The system MAY flag any cart line whose underlying product has since been deactivated or out-of-stock as "unavailable" and exclude it from the displayed grand total.

*Priority:* Could | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* Cart response includes per-line {{available: boolean}}
* Unavailable lines excluded from grand_total
* UI renders unavailable lines greyed out with warning icon
* Checkout (FR-ORD-001) skips unavailable lines

*FR-CART-014:* The system SHOULD require an explicit confirmation prompt on the client before invoking the clear-cart operation.

*Priority:* Should | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* Clicking "Clear cart" opens modal: "Remove all items?"
* Cancel keeps cart intact (no API call)
* Confirm calls DELETE /api/cart
* Individual remove (FR-CART-007) does NOT require confirmation

column1: [FR-CART-013] Cap line quantity at current inventory
column32:
*FR-CART-013:* The system SHALL cap any single cart line's quantity at the product's current inventory_count; attempts to exceed this MUST return HTTP 409 with the available stock value.

*Priority:* Should | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* PUT qty=N where N > inventory_count → 409 with {available: M}
* UI caps quantity at available stock and shows message
* Re-check stock on every PUT (not cached)

column1: [FR-CART-012] Reject cart endpoints without valid JWT
column32:
*FR-CART-012:* The system SHALL reject all cart endpoints when the request lacks a valid JWT, returning HTTP 401.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* All 5 cart endpoints (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE x2) return 401 without JWT
* Expired JWT also returns 401
* Inherits auth dependency from FR-AUTH-008

column1: [FR-CART-011] Auto-clear cart after successful order creation
column32:
*FR-CART-011:* The system SHALL automatically clear the cart immediately after successful order creation (see FR-ORD-005).

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* Successful POST /api/orders → cart empty on next GET
* Clear happens inside the same DB transaction as order creation (NFR-REL-003)
* Failed order does NOT clear cart

column1: [FR-CART-010] Live cart item-count badge in header
column32:
*FR-CART-010:* The system SHALL display a real-time cart item-count badge in the application header on every authenticated page.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* Badge visible on all authenticated pages
* Updates within 200ms of any cart change (optimistic)
* Reconciles with server response

column1: [FR-CART-009] Block adding inactive or out-of-stock product
column32:
*FR-CART-009:* The system SHALL prevent adding a product whose inventory_count is 0 or whose is_active flag is false, returning HTTP 409 Conflict with a human-readable reason.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* Add inactive product → 409 reason=PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE
* Add OOS product → 409 reason=OUT_OF_STOCK
* UI shows toast and refreshes catalog

column1: [FR-CART-008] Clear entire cart in one operation
column32:
*FR-CART-008:* The system SHALL allow a user to clear their entire cart in a single operation.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* DELETE /api/cart returns 204
* Subsequent GET returns empty cart
* Idempotent — clearing empty cart still returns 204

*FR-CART-007:* The system SHALL allow a user to remove a single cart line.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* DELETE /api/cart/items/{id} returns 204
* Line gone from subsequent GET /api/cart
* 404 if line id does not belong to caller

*FR-CART-006:* The system SHALL reject quantity updates of 0 or negative values with HTTP 400; removal must use the delete endpoint.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* PUT quantity=0 returns 400
* PUT quantity=-1 returns 400
* Response message hints user to use DELETE for removal

*FR-CART-005:* The system SHALL allow a user to update the quantity of any cart line to any positive integer ≥ 1.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* PUT /api/cart/items/{id} {quantity: N} returns 200
* New quantity reflected in subsequent GET /api/cart
* 404 if cart line id does not belong to caller

column1: [FR-CART-004] Retrieve cart with totals and item details
column32:
*FR-CART-004:* The system SHALL allow a user to retrieve their current cart, returning per-line product details (name, image, unit price), line total, item count, and grand total.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* GET /api/cart returns 200 with {items[], item_count, grand_total}
* Each item has id, product_id, product_name, image_url, unit_price, quantity, line_total
* Empty cart returns 200 with item_count=0, grand_total=0

*FR-CART-003:* The system SHALL persist cart contents server-side, keyed to the authenticated user, so the cart survives across sessions and devices.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* Cart survives logout/login on same browser
* Cart appears on second browser/device with same user
* Open question: should carts auto-expire after N days?

column1: [FR-CART-002] Increment qty when adding existing product
column32:
*FR-CART-002:* When a user adds a product that already exists in their cart, the system SHALL increment the existing line's quantity rather than creating a duplicate line.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* Adding product X (qty 1) twice produces ONE line with qty=2
* Adding product X (qty 1) then X (qty 3) produces ONE line with qty=4
* No duplicate cart_item rows in DB

column1: [FR-CART-001] Add product to authenticated user's cart
column32:
*FR-CART-001:* The system SHALL allow an authenticated user to add a product to their cart by product ID and quantity.

*Priority:* Must (MVP) | *Epic:* ECOM-8
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. AC

* POST /api/cart/items {product_id, quantity} returns 201
* Quantity defaults to 1 if omitted
* Returns 401 without JWT (FR-CART-012)

*Requirement (FR-CAT-013):* The system MAY return a "category facets" aggregation alongside list responses to power a counted filter UI.

*Priority:* Could
*Epic:* ECOM-7
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Response envelope includes {{facets: { categories: [{name, count}, ...] }}}
* Counts reflect current filter context (e.g., search keyword applied)
* Frontend renders sidebar with category names + counts

column1: [FR-CAT-012] Frontend placeholder for broken product images
column32: *Requirement (FR-CAT-012):* The frontend SHALL display a placeholder image when image_url fails to load. *Priority:* Should *Epic:* ECOM-7 *Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097 h3. Acceptance criteria * onError handler on {{}} swaps to placeholder * Placeholder is a local asset (no network dependency) * Alt text preserved for screen readers

column1: [FR-CAT-011] Deterministic default sort + sort query param
column32:
*Requirement (FR-CAT-011):* The system SHOULD sort the product list by a deterministic default (e.g., id ascending) and SHOULD accept a sort query parameter (price asc/desc, name).

*Priority:* Should
*Epic:* ECOM-7
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Acceptance criteria

* No sort param → default order (id ascending)
* {{?sort=price_asc}} → ascending price
* {{?sort=price_desc}} → descending price
* {{?sort=name}} → alphabetical
* Invalid sort value returns 400

*Requirement (FR-CAT-010):* The system SHOULD paginate the product list once the catalog exceeds 50 products (cursor- or page-based).

*Priority:* Should (v1.1)
*Epic:* ECOM-7
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Acceptance criteria

* {{?page=1&limit=20}} returns paged results (or cursor equivalent)
* Default page size ≤ 50
* Response envelope includes total count or next-cursor

column1: [FR-CAT-009] Seed at least 6 demo products in ≥ 2 categories
column32:
*Requirement (FR-CAT-009):* The system SHALL ship with at least 6 seeded products spanning ≥ 2 categories, for testing and demos.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-7
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Acceptance criteria

* DB seed creates ≥ 6 products
* ≥ 2 distinct categories represented
* Each product has name, description, price, image_url, category, inventory_count
* Seed script idempotent

*Requirement (FR-CAT-008):* Product list and detail endpoints SHALL be readable without authentication; mutating endpoints (create / update — see ECOM-10) SHALL require admin role.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-7
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Acceptance criteria

* GET /api/products and /api/products/{id} work without Authorization header
* POST/PUT/DELETE /api/products return 403 for non-admin
* POST/PUT/DELETE /api/products return 401 if no token

column1: [FR-CAT-007] Exclude inactive products from list and search
column32:
*Requirement (FR-CAT-007):* The system SHALL exclude inactive (is_active = false) products from list and search results.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-7
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Acceptance criteria

* GET /api/products never returns is_active=false items
* Search results also exclude inactive
* Detail endpoint returns 404 for inactive ids

*Requirement (FR-CAT-006):* The system SHALL include each product's current inventory_count (or a derived "in stock" boolean) in list and detail responses.

*User story:* As a shopper, I want to see whether a product is in stock so that I don't add unavailable items.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-7
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Each product item includes {{inventory_count}} and/or {{in_stock}} boolean
* UI shows "Out of stock" badge when inventory_count = 0
* Open question: surface exact count or just buckets?

*Requirement (FR-CAT-005):* The system SHALL provide a single-product retrieve endpoint returning all product attributes for a given id.

*User story:* As a shopper, I want to view the full details of a single product so that I can make an informed buying decision.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-7
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Acceptance criteria

* GET /api/products/{id} returns full product object
* Unknown id returns 404
* Inactive product returns 404 (treat as not found)

*Requirement (FR-CAT-004):* The system SHALL allow filters to combine (category AND search keyword).

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-7
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Acceptance criteria

* {{?category=X&search=keyword}} returns intersection (AND, not OR)
* Either param alone still works independently

*Requirement (FR-CAT-003):* The system SHALL support filtering products by category via a query parameter.

*User story:* As a shopper, I want to filter products by category so that I can narrow to my area of interest.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-7
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Acceptance criteria

* {{?category=Apparel}} returns only that category
* Unknown category returns 200 with {{[]}}
* Category match is exact (not fuzzy in v1)

column1: [FR-CAT-002] Keyword search on product name and description
column32:
*Requirement (FR-CAT-002):* The system SHALL support search over product name and description via a {{search}} query parameter (case-insensitive substring match in MVP).

*User story:* As a shopper, I want to search products by keyword so that I can find a specific item.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-7
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Acceptance criteria

* {{?search=backpack}} returns matching products
* Match is case-insensitive
* Match scans both name and description fields
* Zero matches returns 200 with {{[]}}

*Requirement (FR-CAT-001):* The system SHALL list all active products (is_active = true) via a list endpoint.

*User story:* As a shopper, I want to browse all active products in a grid so that I can quickly survey what's available.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-7
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Acceptance criteria

* GET /api/products returns 200 with JSON array
* Only active products included (FR-CAT-007)
* Empty catalog returns 200 with {{[]}}

*Requirement (FR-AUTH-015):* The system MAY support OAuth 2.0 social login (Google, GitHub) in a future release.

*Priority:* Could (v2)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* "Sign in with Google" button on login page
* OAuth callback creates / links user account
* Mapping: oauth_subject ↔ ECOM user id
* Email collision policy: link to existing account if email matches

*Requirement (FR-AUTH-014):* The system SHOULD provide a password-reset flow via email link.

*User story:* As a future user, I want to reset my password by email so that I can recover access without contacting support.

*Priority:* Should (v1.1)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* POST /api/auth/password-reset accepts email, sends one-time link
* Link expires after 1 hour
* Link is single-use
* Submitting new password updates hash and invalidates outstanding tokens

*Requirement (FR-AUTH-013):* The system SHOULD provide a refresh-token mechanism to extend sessions without long-lived access tokens.

*Priority:* Should (v1.1)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Login also issues a refresh_token (≤ 7 day expiry — NFR-SEC-004)
* POST /api/auth/refresh exchanges valid refresh_token for new access_token
* Refresh tokens stored server-side (revocable)
* Refresh tokens rotate on use (no replay)

column1: [FR-AUTH-012] Seed three test users for automated testing
column32:
*Requirement (FR-AUTH-012):* The system SHALL provide three pre-seeded test users (standard_user, problem_user, performance_user) for automated testing.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* DB seed script creates 3 users with password {{secret_sauce}}
* All three authenticate successfully via POST /api/auth/login
* Seeded data idempotent (re-seeding does not error or duplicate)

*Requirement (FR-AUTH-011):* The system SHALL enforce password complexity: minimum 8 characters, at least one letter and one digit. Stronger rules MAY be added later.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Register with password < 8 chars returns 422
* Register with password missing digit returns 422
* Register with password missing letter returns 422
* Server-side validation is authoritative (client validates too for UX)

*Requirement (FR-AUTH-010):* The frontend SHALL automatically redirect users to the login page when an API response returns 401.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Axios response interceptor catches 401
* Token cleared from localStorage
* Router redirects to /login
* Toast shown: "Session expired, please log in again"

*Requirement (FR-AUTH-009):* The frontend SHALL store the JWT in browser localStorage for v1 and SHALL clear it on logout.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Successful login sets {{auth_token}} in localStorage
* Logout removes {{auth_token}} from localStorage
* Page reload reads token from localStorage and restores auth context

h3. Open question

Move to httpOnly cookie in v1.1? (CSRF vs XSS trade-off)

column1: [FR-AUTH-008] Reject protected endpoints without valid JWT
column32:
*Requirement (FR-AUTH-008):* The system SHALL reject any request that omits or presents an invalid / expired JWT on a protected endpoint with HTTP 401.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Missing Authorization header → 401
* Malformed bearer token → 401
* Tampered signature → 401
* Expired token → 401
* Verification dependency applied to all protected routes

*Requirement (FR-AUTH-007):* The system SHALL provide an endpoint that returns the authenticated user's profile (id, username, email, first/last name).

*User story:* As a logged-in user, I want to see my profile so that I can verify the right account is in use.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* GET /api/auth/me with valid JWT returns 200 + profile JSON
* Profile excludes password hash
* Returns 401 if JWT missing/invalid (FR-AUTH-008)

*Requirement (FR-AUTH-006):* The system SHALL sign JWTs with HS256 using a server-side secret and SHALL set an expiry no longer than 30 minutes by default.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* JWT alg header = HS256
* exp claim ≤ now + 30 min
* Secret sourced from env var (not source code) — NFR-SEC-003

*Requirement (FR-AUTH-005):* The system SHALL return HTTP 401 for invalid credentials without revealing which of username / password was wrong.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Unknown username returns 401
* Known username with wrong password returns 401
* Both responses are identical (no field-specific message)
* Deactivated user (is_active=false) login also returns 401

*Requirement (FR-AUTH-004):* The system SHALL allow registered users to authenticate by submitting username and password, issuing a JWT on success.

*User story:* As a returning user, I want to log in so that I can resume where I left off.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* POST /api/auth/login with valid creds returns 200 + JWT
* Response body: {{{ access_token, token_type: "bearer" }}}
* JWT contains sub=user_id and exp claim

*Requirement (FR-AUTH-003):* The system SHALL hash passwords with bcrypt (≥ 12 rounds) before persistence. Plaintext passwords MUST NOT be logged or returned in any API response.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Stored password hash starts with {{$2b$12$}} or stronger
* No endpoint returns the password field
* Application logs do not contain the plaintext password
* Pair with NFR-SEC-002

column1: [FR-AUTH-002] Enforce uniqueness of username and email
column32:
*Requirement (FR-AUTH-002):* The system SHALL enforce uniqueness of username and email, returning HTTP 409 on conflict.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Attempt to register an existing username returns 409
* Attempt to register an existing email returns 409
* Error message is generic (no leak of which field clashed)

*Requirement (FR-AUTH-001):* The system SHALL allow a visitor to register a new account by providing username, email, password, first name, and last name.

*User story:* As a new visitor, I want to register an account so that I can start shopping and persist a cart.

*Priority:* Must (MVP)
*Epic:* ECOM-6
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Acceptance criteria

* POST /api/auth/register accepts username, email, password, first_name, last_name
* Returns 201 on success with the created user (no password)
* Field validation rejects malformed input with 422

h2. Observability & Compliance

Structured logging, metrics, traces, audit logs, alerts, error tracking, GDPR data subject runbook, retention policy.

*Requirement ID prefix:* {{NFR-OBS-*}}
*Priority:* MVP (mixed Must / Should)
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1703937

h3. Headline targets

* 100% structured request logs
* Prometheus /metrics endpoint
* Logs ≥ 30d retention; audit logs ≥ 365d
* Alerts on error rate / p95 / readiness
* No PII in INFO/DEBUG logs

h3. Scope (12 tasks)

h2. Maintainability & Portability

Test coverage, lint/type cleanliness, 12-factor config, Docker, SQLite↔Postgres portability, single-command bootstrap, OpenAPI documentation, code organisation.

*Requirement ID prefix:* {{NFR-MNT-*}}
*Priority:* MVP
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1671170

h3. Headline targets

* Backend coverage ≥ 80%; frontend ≥ 70%
* Lint + types clean in CI
* Single-command bootstrap (make dev / docker compose up)
* Cyclomatic complexity ≤ 10/fn

h3. Scope (14 tasks)

h2. Usability & Accessibility

WCAG 2.1 AA, keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, responsive design across mobile/tablet/desktop, color contrast, focus indicators.

*Requirement ID prefix:* {{NFR-USE-*}}
*Priority:* MVP
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1638443

h3. Headline targets

* WCAG 2.1 AA on all primary flows
* Lighthouse Accessibility ≥ 90
* Three responsive breakpoints
* Last 2 versions of Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge

h3. Scope (12 tasks)

h2. Reliability & Availability

Uptime, graceful degradation, transactional integrity, backups, MTTR, stateless API for zero-downtime rolling deploy.

*Requirement ID prefix:* {{NFR-REL-*}}
*Priority:* MVP
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1638422

h3. Headline targets

* ≥ 99.5% uptime SLO
* MTTR ≤ 30 min
* Daily backups, quarterly restore drill
* Liveness + readiness probes
* ≤ 5 min rollback

h3. Scope (10 tasks)

h2. Security & Privacy

OWASP Top 10 coverage, bcrypt password hashing, JWT hardening, TLS, CORS, security headers, dependency scanning, PII handling.

*Requirement ID prefix:* {{NFR-SEC-*}}
*Priority:* MVP (mostly Must)
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1638401

h3. Headline targets

* 100% OWASP Top 10 coverage
* bcrypt ≥ 12 rounds; JWT ≤ 30 min expiry
* HTTPS / HSTS in non-local environments
* SAST in CI; critical CVEs block merge

h3. Scope (15 tasks)

h2. Performance & Scalability

API latency, throughput, frontend perf, horizontal scaling, caching. Measurable thresholds verified via load test (k6/Locust) and Lighthouse CI.

*Requirement ID prefix:* {{NFR-PERF-*}}
*Priority:* MVP (mixed Must / Should)
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1605633

h3. Headline targets

* API p50 ≤ 100 ms, p95 ≤ 300 ms, p99 ≤ 800 ms
* ≥ 100 RPS sustained on catalog reads
* Lighthouse Performance ≥ 85
* Bundle ≤ 200 KB gzipped initial route
* 200 concurrent users supported

h3. Scope (10 tasks)

h2. Admin & Inventory (v2)

Operational surface for staff: catalog CRUD, inventory adjustments, order status transitions, user management, audit log. Introduces role-based access control (USER / ADMIN).

*Requirement ID prefix:* {{FR-ADM-*}}
*Priority:* v2 / FUTURE
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1114135

h3. Scope (12 tickets)

* Role attribute on User
* Product create / update / soft-deactivate
* Inventory adjustments with audit
* List all orders, transition status
* Deactivate user accounts
* Admin metrics endpoints
* Audit log for all admin actions

h3. Dependencies

Extension of 4.1 Authentication (role attribute).

h2. Checkout & Order Management

Converts a cart into a persisted order: line items, prices-at-purchase, shipping address, placeholder payment method. Atomic stock decrement, cart clear, order insert. Order lifecycle: PENDING → CONFIRMED → SHIPPED → DELIVERED (or CANCELLED).

*Requirement ID prefix:* {{FR-ORD-*}}
*Priority:* MVP (P0)
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1572866

h3. Scope (15 stories)

* Order creation, list, detail
* Atomic stock decrement, price snapshot
* Owner-only access (404 not 403 on foreign orders)
* Status lifecycle
* v1.1: cancel order, idempotency key, email confirmation

h3. Dependencies

4.1 Authentication, 4.2 Catalog, 4.3 Cart.

h2. Shopping Cart

Lets an authenticated shopper collect products before checkout. Cart contents are persisted server-side, scoped per user, and survive across sessions and devices. Auto-cleared on successful order creation.

*Requirement ID prefix:* {{FR-CART-*}}
*Priority:* MVP (P0)
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1146881

h3. Scope (15 stories)

* Add / view / update / remove / clear
* Per-user server-side persistence
* Stock and active-product validation
* Live cart-badge in header
* Auto-clear after checkout

h3. Dependencies

4.1 Authentication, 4.2 Catalog.

h2. Product Catalog & Browsing

Read-mostly catalog surface that lets shoppers browse, search, filter, and inspect products. Mutating endpoints are admin-only (see ADM epic).

*Requirement ID prefix:* {{FR-CAT-*}}
*Priority:* MVP (P0)
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1540097

h3. Scope (13 stories)

* List products, search by keyword, filter by category, combined filters
* Single-product detail endpoint
* Inventory / in-stock surfacing
* Seeded products for demos
* v1.1: pagination, sort, faceted aggregation

h3. Dependencies

4.1 Authentication (for purchase actions only — browsing is public).

h2. Authentication & User Management

Foundational subsystem providing user registration, JWT-based login, session continuity, and identity retrieval. Every other subsystem (Cart, Orders) depends on the authenticated user identity it produces.

*Requirement ID prefix:* {{FR-AUTH-*}}
*Priority:* MVP (P0)
*Wiki:* https://meetuchandra-1781427506328.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/QA/pages/1507329

h3. Scope (15 stories)

* Register, login, logout, JWT issuance & verification
* Profile retrieval, password rules
* Seeded test users (standard_user / problem_user / performance_user)
* v1.1: refresh tokens, password reset
* v2 (future): OAuth social login

h3. Dependencies

None — foundational.
